notes: Verified high-priority Baltimore jazz discoveries missing from canonical RADAR on 2026-08-15. events.factual_description: Keystone Korner Baltimore presents NEA Jazz Master Hubert Laws for two sets on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 5:00 PM and 8:00 PM. The venue's authorized InstantSeats page confirms both performances and identifies Laws as a jazz flutist whose work also spans classical, R&B and pop contexts.

provenance.note: Date and showtimes verified on Keystone Korner Baltimore's current calendar and authorized InstantSeats event page. Apple Music recommendation verified as an exact album page.

en.why_it_matters: Hubert Laws is a rare case where the instrument itself is part of the reason to go: a living master who made flute a serious lead voice across jazz, classical repertoire and groove-oriented music. Hearing that sound in Keystone Korner's small room is much more distinctive than a routine legacy booking.
en.trip_verdict: S regional. Worth the Baltimore drive on its own if instrumental identity and living-master jazz are the draw.

es.why_it_matters: Hubert Laws es uno de esos casos raros en los que el instrumento mismo es parte de la razón para ir: un maestro vivo que convirtió la flauta en una voz principal seria entre jazz, repertorio clásico y música con groove. Escuchar ese sonido en la escala íntima de Keystone Korner es mucho más singular que una fecha rutinaria de legado.
es.trip_verdict: S regional. Sí vale el viaje a Baltimore por sí solo si el atractivo es la identidad instrumental y escuchar a un maestro vivo.

events.factual_description: Terri Lyne Carrington + Social Science play Keystone Korner Baltimore on Friday and Saturday, December 18-19, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The authorized ticket page presents the engagement in connection with the Social Science album Trip The Night Fantastic and describes the project's mix of jazz, R&B, indie rock, contemporary improvisation and hip-hop.

provenance.note: Dates, showtimes and project context verified on Keystone Korner Baltimore and its authorized InstantSeats page. Apple Music recommendations verified as exact album pages.

en.why_it_matters: Carrington is not being booked here merely as a decorated drummer. Social Science is the point: rhythm, improvisation, politics and contemporary Black music are treated as one language, and the new-project context makes this a live proposition rather than a retrospective master-class date.
en.trip_verdict: S regional. Protect one of the four sets; the combination of a living master, an active band concept and a small room makes Baltimore worth the drive.
en.listen_before: Trip the Night Fantastic; Waiting Game

es.why_it_matters: Carrington no aparece aquí simplemente como una baterista condecorada. El punto es Social Science: ritmo, improvisación, política y música negra contemporánea tratados como un solo lenguaje, y el contexto del proyecto nuevo hace que sea una propuesta viva, no una clase magistral retrospectiva.
es.trip_verdict: S regional. Hay que proteger uno de los cuatro sets; la combinación de una maestra viva, un concepto de banda activo y un club pequeño hace que Baltimore valga el viaje.
es.listen_before: Trip the Night Fantastic; Waiting Game
